fullPassage: The "veil of ignorance" is a concept that was first proposed by the political philosopher John Rawls. The idea can be summed up as follows: When setting up laws for a society, you should assume that you could end up in any social position. By doing so, you can avoid being biased by your current situation. Following this way of thinking, people would likely reject slavery because there is a chance that they could find themselves as slaves instead of slave owners. Rawls believed that by keeping the "veil of ignorance" in mind, society would naturally adopt fair, social-democratic policies. When you don't know where you will be on the socioeconomic ladder, strong redistribution and generous social welfare policies become much more attractive.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) assume=가정하다 / doubt=의심하다 (B) avoid=피하다 / seek=추구하다 (C) reject=거부하다 / accept=받아들이다
det.analysis:
① assume—avoid—reject: 어떤 위치든 될 수 있다고 '가정하고' + 편향을 '피하며' + 노예제를 '거부한다' ←정답

④ doubt—seek—reject: (A)(B) 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 어떤 위치든 될 수 있다 assume(가정) → 편향 avoid(피함) → 노예제 reject(거부)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: set(동사: 세우다, 정하다) → setting. 'When + -ing'는 '~할 때'를 나타내는 분사구문
det.analysis: 동사 set을 현재분사 setting으로 바꿔요. 'When setting up laws ~'는 'When you set up laws'를 줄인 분사구문으로 '법을 세울 때'라는 뜻이에요. 접속사 When 뒤에 주어 없이 동사가 오면 '-ing' 형태(현재분사)가 되어야 하므로 원형 set이 아니라 setting이 맞아요.
det.tip: When + -ing = ~할 때(분사구문). set → setting

questions.passage: The "veil of ignorance" is a concept that was first __________ (propose) by the political philosopher John Rawls. Rawls believed that society would naturally adopt fair, social-democratic policies.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: propose(동사: 제안하다) → proposed. 'be동사 + 과거분사'는 '~되다'라는 수동태
det.analysis: 동사 propose를 과거분사 proposed로 바꿔요. 'was first proposed by ~'는 'be동사(was) + 과거분사(proposed)' 구조의 수동태로 '~에 의해 처음 제안되었다'라는 뜻이에요. 개념이 스스로 제안한 게 아니라 철학자에 '의해 제안된' 것이라 수동태 과거분사 proposed가 필요해요.
det.tip: was + 과거분사 = ~되었다(수동태). propose → proposed

questions.passage: The "veil of ignorance" is a concept that was first proposed by the political philosopher John Rawls. The idea can be summed up as follows: When setting up laws for a society, you should assume that you could __________ in any social position. By doing so, you can avoid being biased by your current situation. Following this way of thinking, people would likely reject slavery because there is a chance that they could find themselves as slaves instead of slave owners. Rawls believed that by keeping the "veil of ignorance" in mind, society would naturally adopt fair, social-democratic policies. When you don't know where you will be on the socioeconomic ladder, strong redistribution and generous social welfare policies become much more attractive.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: end up=결국 ~한 처지가 되다 / give up=포기하다 / look up=찾아보다 / take up=차지하다
det.analysis:
① end up: 어떤 사회적 위치에든 '결국 처하게 될' 수 있다 ←정답
② give up: 포기하다 — 문맥 무관
③ look up: 찾아보다 — 문맥 무관
④ take up: 차지하다 — 문맥 부적절
det.tip: you could __________ in any social position → 결국 ~한 처지가 되다(end up)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: give themselves=자신을 바치다 / enjoy themselves=즐기다 / find themselves=자신이 ~한 처지임을 깨닫다 / help themselves=마음껏 먹다
det.analysis:
① give themselves: 자신을 바치다 — 문맥 부적절
② enjoy themselves: 즐기다 — 문맥 무관
③ find themselves: 노예 주인이 아니라 '노예의 처지에 놓일' 수 있음 ←정답
④ help themselves: 마음껏 먹다 — 문맥 무관
det.tip: they could __________ as slaves instead of slave owners → 자신이 노예임을 깨닫다(find themselves)
